COSTUME AND MACHINE DESIGN MUST BE GERMAN/PRUSSIAN/EUROPEAN military design: field-gray fitted tunics, M35 steel helmets or M43/peaked caps, leather boots/belts; German angular armored vehicles, European cavalry, German aircraft and industrial/naval silhouettes as specified. NO Japanese uniforms, kimono, samurai armor, katanas or Japanese aircraft. Cohesive gray-green, charcoal, ivory and muted crimson palette, cinematic lighting, readable centered main subject occupying 75 percent of scene. All people are adults with modest practical clothing. ARTWORK ONLY: no words, numbers, card frame, UI, watermark, real political insignia or flags. Adult anime German-style tactical strategist in field-gray officer tunic and peaked cap inside a tall concrete German observation/command tower, speaking into a field radio over a map. One allied Panzer marker emits an additional glowing attack arrow outside the window, emphasizing delegated extra attack rather than a gun tower.
